summary: A form from David Crocker asking sites to supply information about their ARPANET TIPs, the Terminal IMPs used to reach the network. The collected details were meant to give TIP users more flexibility and make network use easier. Responses were to be sent to him, preferably as a NIC Journal entry.

eli5.summary: A paper form asking people who set up the network's dial-in boxes to describe them, so users can learn how to use them.
